f.pu: To protect a biodiverse marine national park, composed of 6 islands off the coast of Mahe. The site is unique as it was the first established marine park in the Indian Ocean in 1973. The vast marine park is home to numerous marine species and contains expansive seagrass meadows full of corals.
f.re: 1.
